en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a European city square with ornate buildings and a large fountain in the foreground. The caption at the bottom reads 'Sundsvall Esplanaden och Torget', indicating it depicts an area in Sundsvall, Sweden. The reverse shows handwritten Swedish text, Swedish stamps, and a postmark, alongside a printed address to Helsingborg.
